Replay the ImmutableDB of a local Cardano node database

Usage: dolos bootstrap immutabledb [OPTIONS] --source <PATH>

Options:
      --force                    Replace any data already in storage
      --source <PATH>            the Cardano node database directory to replay: the one holding
                                 `immutable/` and `protocolMagicId`, as cardano-node and a Mithril
                                 download leave it. Only read, never written
      --continue                 Resume an interrupted replay from its committed position, over the
                                 data it left in storage
      --skip-if-data             Exit 0 without bootstrapping when storage already holds a node, as
                                 an interrupted replay that has committed leaves one for
                                 `--continue` to resume; data without one, as a bootstrap
                                 interrupted before it commits a cursor leaves, and a store this
                                 release refuses are errors instead
      --stop-epoch <N>           Stop once the ledger reaches this epoch
      --verbose                  Enable verbose logging output
      --chunk-size <CHUNK_SIZE>  Number of blocks to process in each chunk, more is faster but uses
                                 more memory [default: 500]
  -c, --config <CONFIG>          
  -h, --help                     Print help
